title: Foam insulation installed in the walls and roof underside of a house; notice to fix

facts.text: Partly completed single-storey detached house on a near-level rural site in a high wind zone; the floor plan is H-shaped with bedrooms in one wing and living areas in another.
The consent detailed fibreglass batts; foam insulation was installed into the walls and the underside of the roof before a consent amendment was sought.

Figure 1 is a north elevation annotated with a change to vertical fibre cement weatherboards on a drained cavity (p.1); Figure 2 is a simplified consent section (p.2); Figure 3 shows roof insulation to the east-wing sloping ceilings (p.3).
The matter covers E2 for the as-built walls and roof insulated with foam, and H1 for the building as a whole.
